name: bow
note: The first pose of the catapult launch sequence, found with the pose editor (G2 held in the air, instant jumps): front legs squatted (shoulders -9, knees -3), back legs extended (shoulders -19, knees 84), claw closed (jaw 0) with the lift at 135. The lift reaches 135 only by a direct command: a data skill clips every angle at 125.
